messages.subject: Looking for help
parts:
Dear all,

 Literature said that the smaller value of the KLD is an indicator that the posterior distribution is well approximated by normal distribution.  Thus this is kindly to ask you that:
- what is the red line  to say KLD is minimum?
- what we can say about the posterior distribution if the KLD is not minimum?

I always appreciate your your help


With Best Regards

Endale

messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Looking for help
parts:
don't know. the interpretation of the (sqrt of the) KLD is not very
clear. sqrt(KLD) has a interpretation as a (uni-directional) distance,
so 4 is twice as far as 2, and then there is the effect of the
dimension.
